# Community Rule Column 5 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 5 | **Condition:** complete

---

**5:1** And this is the rule for the men of the community who volunteer to turn from all evil and to hold fast to all that He has commanded according to His will: to separate

**5:2** from the congregation of the men of injustice, to become a community in Torah and in possessions, submitting to the authority of the Sons of Zadok, the priests who keep

**5:3** the covenant, and to the authority of the assembly of the men of the community who hold fast to the covenant. By their authority the decision by lot shall be determined regarding every matter

**5:4** of Torah, of possessions, and of judgment, to practice truth together, and humility,

**5:5** and righteousness, and justice, and lovingkindness, and to walk humbly in all their ways. Let no one walk in the stubbornness of his heart,

**5:6** going astray after his heart and his eyes and the schemes of his inclination. Rather, he shall circumcise in the community the willfulness of his inclination and the stiff neck,

**5:7** to lay a foundation of truth for Israel, for the community of an everlasting covenant, to make atonement for all who volunteer for holiness in Aaron and for a house of truth

**5:8** in Israel, and for those who join them for community life. In judgment and in trial and in conduct according to all these statutes, when they enter

**5:9** the community, everyone who enters the council of the community shall enter the covenant of God in the sight of all who volunteer, and he shall take upon himself a binding oath

**5:10** to return to the Torah of Moses according to all that He has commanded, with all his heart and with all his soul,

**5:11** to all that has been revealed from it to the Sons of Zadok, the priests who keep the covenant and who seek His will, and to the assembly of the men of

**5:12** their covenant who volunteer together for His truth and to walk according to His will. He shall bind himself by the covenant to separate

**5:13** from all the men of injustice who walk in the way of wickedness. For these are not reckoned in His covenant, since they have neither sought nor inquired

**5:14** after His statutes, to know the hidden things in which they have gone astray to their guilt, and the revealed things they have done defiantly,

**5:15** arousing anger for judgment and for the execution of the curses of the covenant, to bring upon them great judgments unto eternal destruction without remnant.

**5:16** He shall not enter the water to touch the purity of the holy men, for they will not be cleansed unless they have turned from their wickedness,

**5:17** for all who transgress His word are impure. No one shall have dealings with him in his work or in his possessions, lest he be burdened

**5:18** with the guilt of his iniquity. Rather, he shall keep far from him in every matter, for thus it is written: "From every false thing you shall keep far."

**5:19** And every man of the community shall be tested, each according to his spirit, one with another, regarding his understanding and his deeds in Torah,

**5:20** under the authority of the Sons of Aaron who volunteer in the community to establish His covenant and to observe all His statutes which He commanded to perform,

**5:21** and under the authority of the majority of Israel who volunteer to return in the community to His covenant.

**5:22** They shall be enrolled in order, each before his neighbor, according to his understanding and his deeds, so that each shall obey his neighbor, the junior obeying the senior.

**5:23** Their spirit and their deeds shall be tested year by year, to promote each one according to his understanding and the perfection of his way,

**5:24** or to demote him according to his failings. Each man shall reprove his neighbor in truth, humility, and lovingkindness.

**5:25** Let no one speak to his brother in anger, or in resentment, or with a stiff neck, or with a jealous and wicked spirit.

**5:26** Let him not hate him in the stubbornness of his heart, but on that very day he shall reprove him and not incur sin on his account.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering adjudicated from EMET (literal), LOGOS (formal), and PNEUMA (dynamic). "Lovingkindness" for hesed adopted from LOGOS. "Sons of Zadok" capitalized as priestly designation. "Assembly" for rabbim as compromise between EMET "multitude," LOGOS "Congregation," and PNEUMA "full assembly." "Willfulness of his inclination" at 5:6 blends EMET's literal foreskin metaphor with PNEUMA's accessibility. See disagreement log for all divergences.*
